Philosophy of Language - Landscape and Taxonomy

sections.text: Philosophy of language asks: how do words, sentences, and utterances connect to the world, to meaning, and to minds? It sits at the intersection of logic, metaphysics, epistemology, and linguistics. For a TCS background: this is where the theory of formal languages intersects with the messy structure of natural language, and where semantics as computer scientists use it traces its intellectual lineage.
